# Repair Site

If a frontend exists, reproduce failures, preserve working behavior, patch incrementally, remove dead code only after checking dependencies, and rerun checks.

Read the repository assessment and current site manifest. Record evidence and changes in docs/site-builder/work-log.md. Continue to the next stage unless an actual external authorization boundary remains.
